name: Isotonitazepyne
summary: Isotonitazepyne (N-pyrrolidino-isotonitazene, NPI) is a benzimidazole derivative with potent opioid effects, which has been sold as a designer drug over the internet. Its in vitro potency is approximately 1000 times that of morphine.5 mg of NPI per pill and no oxycodone.
